notes: Primary experimental paper (7 activated carbons from Taisi anthracite, 3 raw and 4 urea-N-doped). H2 uptake measured at 77 K up to 8 MPa on a VTI gravimetric analyzer, with excess isotherms from a volumetric HPVA-II (Micromeritics) in the same conditions (Section 2.2.3). Surface area by N2 BET at 77 K for every sample (Table 3). Not retracted (record.json is_retracted false; no retraction notice in the text). No statement that every H2 uptake value was previously published: Fig. 6 pools 36 earlier non-doped Taisi ACs [7-9,30,50] with 'the 7 ACs reported in this study', and the N-doped samples are new. duplicate_data not applied. No supplementary files in the input.
